scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.lint: npm run lint:shared && npm run lint:api && npm run lint:web
scripts.db:migrate: dotenv -e apps/api/env.development -- npx prisma migrate deploy --schema apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:status: dotenv -e apps/api/env.development -- npx prisma migrate status --schema apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma
